purpose: 接敵、予備動作、攻撃、弾着、damage、hit reaction、撃破、報酬を一つの因果として読み取れるようにし、P2/P3で同一modelを壊さず再構築する。
hardRules: tapまたはpointer入力で敵へ直接damageを与えない。
AUTOは基礎戦闘状態であり、偽active skill buttonを作らない。
damage numberはauthoritative combat eventより前に表示しない。
reward feedbackはreward eventまたはsettlement stateより前に表示しない。
projectile attackはreleaseではなくarrivalをimpact時刻とする。
hit reactionはimpact後に開始し、anticipationと同時開始しない。
defeatはHPまたはauthoritative defeat eventを確認した後だけ開始する。
offline catch-upは高速戦闘を捏造再生せず、照合状態と結果を別表示する。
animation frameごとにキャラクターの体格、模様、装備、顔が変わるassetをrejectする。
reduced motionでも因果、脅威、報酬状態をshape、label、progressで保持する。

timebase.simulation: canonical deterministic tick; render timingから分離
timebase.eventTimestamp: simulation timeを基準とし、wall clockへ依存しない
timebase.speedPolicy: 見た目のdurationはcombat intervalに収めて調整できるが、因果順序とminimum recognition windowを壊さない。

interruptRules: authoritative faintはvisual stateを中断できる
通常hitはattack release前のanticipationを中断する場合だけcombat eventのcancel状態を必要とする
attack release済みprojectileはattacker hit後もarrival eventが存在すれば継続する
reward reactionはcombat threatが再開したら短縮可能
telegraph cancel時は残像を100ms以内に消し、攻撃が来るように見せ続けない

clips.reducedMotion: first pose with occasional non-loop blink no faster than 5s

clips.keyRead: foot contact and body weight; weapon lag
clips.rootMotion: simulation position drives root; clip contains no net displacement
clips.reducedMotion: two-pose step at no more than 4 changes per second

clips.keyRead: weight shifts back、weapon path becomes clear、target direction fixed
Lunaのbow draw、Totoの支援bell timing、projectileまたはheal path preview without damage
single readable arc from preparation to contact
clips.hitRule: combat event confirms impact at contactCandidate; visual does not mint damage
projectileSpawn is not damage; arrival event controls impact

clips.durationMs: 160 to 420 based on actual distance and bounded visual speed
clips.keyRead: clear origin-to-target trajectory with no unreadable teleport
contact flash at enemy hitTarget、short directional lines、dust
clips.occlusionLimit: enemy face/center massの50%を150ms超えて覆わない

clips.keyRead: normalより大きなshape、critical text、追加flash一回
clips.flashLimit: 3 flashes per second未満; full-screen flash禁止

clips.keyRead: impact方向へbody compress後、反対方向へrecoil
stance loss、ground contact、silhouette dissolve。reward sourceを残す
clips.removeRule: reward origin取得前にdisplay objectを破棄しない

clips.keyRead: weapon lower、kneel/curl、non-graphic star or breath cue only if original asset
clips.rule: defeatしたように消さず、field stateとの違いを保持

clips.keyRead: short glance or uplift; combat readiness remains
clips.rule: confirmed or explicitly provisional reward eventなしに再生しない

clips.durationMs: 420 to 900 based on actual attack timing
clips.keyRead: body anticipation plus ground shape plus direction; countdown only if canonical timing exists
clips.rule: 色だけで警告せず、attack canceled時は即座にcancel cue

clips.keyRead: defeat/reward完了後にupward light、floor text exact crossfade、battlefield advance
clips.rule: settlementStatusが進行を許可する前に次floorを確定表示しない

clips.keyRead: battle外縁から配送signifierが入り、対象へeffectを渡して退出
clips.rule: temporarySupport eventがないとき再生しない。常設4体のparty slotへ混入させない。

damageNumber.start: same render frame as authoritative impact or immediately after
damageNumber.motion: 8 to 20px upward with ease-out; never blocks enemy HP
damageNumber.stacking: same target within100msを一つに集約可。ただしcriticalとhealを混ぜない
damageNumber.textSource: exact event amount through canonical formatter

hpBar.zeroRule: defeat event前に視覚上0へ到達してもdefeatを勝手に生成しない
hpBar.unknownRule: unknown値を100%として表示しない

hitStop.scope: attacker, target and contact effect only; UI、timer、accessibility announcementは止めない

gm06Storyboard.purpose: 静止画一枚でも攻撃から報酬までの順序が誤認されない瞬間を定義する。全eventが同時発生したという意味ではない。

timelineMs.event: weapon release or ranged projectile spawn
impact, HP update and damage text begin
enemy hit reaction reaches readable recoil
authoritative defeat begins if HP/event qualifies
reward event creates labeled provisional or confirmed feedback
reward trail reaches destination; next-floor transition may become eligible

captureRequirements: attackerはfollow-through poseで攻撃方向が読める
impact残像とdamage textがenemy hitTargetに残る
enemyはdefeat開始poseで直前の被弾方向が読める
reward feedbackはdefeat sourceと視覚線でつながる
small causal labelsまたはshape sequenceが順序を補い、同時発生を暗示しない

partyLayering.depthSort: footAnchor worldY、同値はstable party slot order
partyLayering.overlapLimit: 各catの顔と主装備のvisible bounds合計65%以上を保持
partyLayering.rule: 四体を同じframe、同じ歩調、同じhorizontal lineへ並べない。

cameraAndSceneMotion.cameraFollow: party centroidを低周波で追従。振幅はstandard viewport幅の3%以下。
cameraAndSceneMotion.tallViewport: 高さ増分は視野と奥行きへ使用し、catを過剰拡大しない
cameraAndSceneMotion.shortViewport: camera cropを詰めてもfootAnchor、enemy HP、attack pathを切らない

motion: labeled progress is determinate only with real progress
unknown progress uses calm non-percent indicator
provisional rows enter without celebratory reward burst
confirmed result may play one reward cue after settlement event
forbidden: server未接続なのに同期完了表示
永久報酬の確定前wallet加算表示

visualRules.provisional: 見込み label、blue edge、wallet destination animationなし
visualRules.confirming: 照合中 label、stable value、spinner may be shown
visualRules.confirmed: 確定 label、green or gold edge、one destination trail
visualRules.rejected: 付与なし label、previous wallet retained、reason or support path

replaced.reward: feedback panel changes from provisional to confirmed without travel
replaced.floorTransition: floor label crossfade 120ms and scene cut

eventInterfaceForP3.uiWriteBack: none from visual animation; only explicit navigation or permitted state toggle actions are emitted

qaMatrix: melee anticipation -> contact -> damage -> hit reaction order
ranged release -> travel -> arrival -> damage order
projectile attacker is hit after release but projectile event remains valid
canceled telegraph clears within100ms and does not deal visual damage
HP reaches zero without defeat event and visual does not invent reward
defeat plus provisional reward remains provisional
confirmed reward deduplicates on rerender and reconnect
four cats overlap at 320x568 without face or weapon loss
30fps and delayed frame maintain event order
reduced motion retains threat, impact, defeat and reward labels
background tab resume uses reconciliation state instead of fabricated catch-up
temporary support remains separate from party4
